name: Notes
nameLatin: NOT THE CORE, BUT NOT DELETED
title: Notes | Takuya Nemoto
description: What is not on the front page: three papers in philosophy, a naval gazette source note, and repositories outside the core. Moved here, not deleted.
taglineHtml: The core of this site is the Trinity-Infinity convergence theorem and its verification. Everything not placed in the core is collected here. None of it has been discarded. The DOIs and the repositories are live. Certificates, areas of study and external profiles are in CV. Nothing here has been peer reviewed either.

papers.title: The Nobility and Exemplarity of the Celibate Individual
papers.subtitle: An Antinatalist and Ascetic Reconsideration of Autonomy and Quality of Life
papers.summary: Argues that the demographic-necessity case for treating sexual activity as obligatory does not survive the antinatalist critique, and defends celibacy as a discipline of autonomous, self-sustaining well-being.

papers.title: Manifesto of Imperial Selfhood
papers.subtitle: An Exploratory Essay on Personal Imperialism and Spiritual Sovereignty
papers.summary: Assembles a reflexive account of self-integration from Kantian legislation, Nietzschean revaluation and Jüngerian mobilisation, treating the tension between them as the structure rather than a defect.

papers.title: Fragmentarian Spiritual Individualism
papers.subtitle: A Philosophy of Fragments for Solitary Spiritual Autonomy
papers.summary: Treats life, faith, society, thought and finitude as discrete fragments rather than one continuous story, and builds a discipline for inhabiting fragmentation rather than repairing it.

papers.title: A Naval Gazette Entry for Lieutenant Otani Tsune（大谷恒）
papers.subtitle: A Note on the Investiture List of 11 September 1943 in the Naval Gazette (Internal Circulation Only), Extra Edition
papers.summary: Transcribes a single investiture entry for an Imperial Japanese Navy lieutenant from a gazette held by JACAR, and separates what the document establishes from what it does not.

works.title: DOI Analyzer
works.summary: Validates DOI syntax, infers the registrant from the prefix, lists where the DOI can be looked up (grouped into indexes, discovery search, and APIs), queries Crossref and DataCite, and exports to BibTeX and other formats. Case, percent-encoding and URL fragments are resolved so that two spellings of one DOI are treated as one, and each export escapes for its own grammar. Also checks ORCID iDs and loads works from an ORCID record. Makes no external request until asked.

works.title: researcher-profile
works.summary: A tool that generates a static researcher profile site from a single configuration file. No dependencies, no external requests.

works.title: justice-and-algorithms
works.summary: A resource mapping the debate on algorithmic decision-making onto theories of justice in political philosophy.

works.title: autonomy-and-self-cultivation
works.summary: The full text, PDFs and citation metadata for the three papers above. The Markdown is transcribed from the PDFs and checked word sequence against word sequence.

works.title: naval-gazette-notes
works.summary: The transcription from the source note above, made machine-readable. Ranks repeated by a ditto mark in the original are expanded per row, with a column separating what was printed from what was carried down.
